Get to know The Pokémon Company International
The Pokémon Company International manages the Pokémon property outside of Asia and is responsible for brand management, licensing and marketing, the Pokémon Trading Card Game, the animated TV series, home entertainment, and the official Pokémon website. Pokémon was launched in Japan in 1996 and today is one of the most popular children’s entertainment properties in the world.
Learn more online at corporate.pokemon.com and pokemon.com .
Get to know the role
Job Title: Software Development Engineer
Job Summary: We're looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to help build the technology that enables our communities, from small gatherings to our largest events. At The Pokémon Company International (TPCi), technology plays a critical role in creating experiences that connect millions of Pokémon fans around the world. In this role, you'll design, develop, and support scalable software solutions while partnering closely with product, design, and engineering teams. You'll tackle complex technical challenges, contribute to architectural discussions and decisions, and help advance engineering best practices. Through strong technical execution and collaboration, you'll play a key role in delivering reliable, innovative, and engaging experiences for the global Pokémon community.
FLSA Classification (US Only): Exempt
People Manager: No
What you’ll do
Software Development & Technical Execution
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software solutions and services.
Lead the implementation of complex features and technical initiatives from design through production.
Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code while adhering to engineering best practices and quality standards.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving software quality, reliability, and performance.
Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
Technical Collaboration & Problem Solving
Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions.
Contribute to technical design discussions and help evaluate architecture, implementation approaches, and tradeoffs.
Break down complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Support system improvements that enhance performance, maintainability, security, and operational excellence.
Identify opportunities to improve development processes, tooling, and team efficiency.
Team Impact
Provide guidance and technical support to other engineers through collaboration, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
Serve as a role model for engineering best practices and continuous learning.
Support a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
What you’ll bring
Experience & Impact
Five (5) to seven (7) years of relevant professional experience or a demonstrated equivalent level of expertise.
Experience delivering software solutions through the full development lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex technical problems and drive work to completion.
Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in an agile environment.
Proven ability to mentor and guide other engineers through technical leadership and knowledge sharing.
Technical Expertise
Experience with full stack development patterns and technologies such as Golang, TypeScript, React, RESTful design patterns, AWS CDK and infrastructure as code, Postgres, NoSQL, and containerized and serverless architectures. Some exposure to Python and JavaScript a plus.
Strong understanding of software development principles, system design fundamentals, and modern engineering practices.
Experience evaluating technical solutions and contributing to architectural and design discussions.
Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement scalable, sustainable solutions.
Core Competencies
Results-oriented with a strong customer focus and commitment to delivering business value.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a continuous improvement mindset.
Ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Growth mindset with a willingness to learn new technologies, adopt evolving practices, and embrace change.
Why This Role Is Special
This role offers the opportunity to work on technology that directly supports how Pokémon fans connect and engage with one another around the world. You'll build solutions that power experiences ranging from local community gatherings to our largest events, while tackling meaningful technical challenges at scale. If you're excited by creating impactful products, collaborating with talented teams, and contributing to experiences that bring joy to millions of fans, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact.
Base Salary Range:  For this role, new hires generally start between $117,485 - $156,318 per year. The full range is $117,485 - $211,605 per year. This range is applicable for the labor market where the role is intended to be hired. The final base salary is directly related to the candidate’s qualifications and professional experience uniquely.
How you’ll be successful
Passion for Pokémon: Develops an understanding of the Pokémon brand, the impact it has on our people, culture, business, fans, and communities, and applying that knowledge and passion to everything you do.
Challenging the Expected: Approaches challenges with curiosity and creativity, embracing the possibility of failure as an opportunity to learn something new, develop innovative ideas, solve complex problems and identify unique opportunities.
Integrity and Respect: Demonstrates integrity and respect by leading with empathy, listening to others, seeking out different perspectives, and taking personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and results.
Dedicated to Quality: Takes ownership to maintain and promote high standards, looks for new ways to learn and improve, and embraces a growth mindset to seek and apply feedback from others in an effort to continuously improve.
Building Relationships: Develops and strengthens relationships, adopting a “team first” mentality and working collaboratively to solve problems and meet shared goals.
Delighting Customers: Listens and understands the interests and needs of our customers and stakeholders, making them feel heard and important, and embracing these learnings to continue delivering a unique Pokémon experience.
